name: Elixir of Agony
summary: In the Undercity, the Elixir of Agony awaits its final treatment. Apothecary Lydon sends his freshly mashed Mudsnout Composite from Tarren Mill to Master Apothecary Faranell, who must add a colloid of decay. The Royal Apothecary Society is developing a new plague for the Forsaken.

sections.title: A Courier to the Capital
sections.body: The Royal Apothecary Society sends discoveries from regional researchers to the Undercity for refinement. In Tarren Mill, Apothecary Lydon has mashed local Mudsnout Blossoms into a composite. Only the capital's laboratory has the advanced reagents needed to make his work lethal.

sections.title: The Master's Urgency
sections.body: Master Apothecary Faranell works under pressure in the Apothecarium. The Scourge threatens from the north, while aggressive human populations press from the south. Lady Sylvanas Windrunner has demanded a potent new plague to defend the Forsaken. Lydon's composite may give Faranell the toxic breakthrough the Dark Lady expects.

faq.q: Why do I need to take the Mudsnout Composite to the Undercity?
faq.answer: Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill lacks the reagents to finish this stage of his experiment. Master Apothecary Faranell has a colloid of decay in the Apothecarium and must apply it to the Mudsnout Composite before the mixture can progress.

Master Apothecary Faranell leads the Royal Apothecary Society from his laboratory deep in the Undercity. He oversees the Forsaken's major chemical and alchemical research and answers directly to Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.

faq.q: What is the new plague the apothecaries keep mentioning?
faq.answer: The new plague is a Forsaken project commanded by Lady Sylvanas. It is made to annihilate both the living and the undead Scourge, giving the Forsaken an absolute weapon against their enemies.

faq.q: Where can I find Master Apothecary Faranell?
faq.answer: Faranell lives in the Apothecarium, the Undercity's southwestern quarter. The quarter is devoted to alchemy, poison brewing, and surgical experimentation.

faq.q: What is Apothecary Lydon trying to create?
faq.answer: Lydon is making the Elixir of Agony, a virulent toxin brewed from Hillsbrad flora and decay agents. It is designed to prove the effectiveness of new strains in the field.

faq.q: Why is the Royal Apothecary Society so rushed?
faq.answer: The Forsaken face threats on every side. The Scourge of Northrend threatens to overrun them, while human resistance from the south presses them. They urgently need a decisive biological weapon.

angles.text: As an Undead, each delivery of raw plant matter to Faranell helps defend the Forsaken and secure their survival against the living and the Scourge.
As a member of the Horde, you rely on Forsaken territory to hold northern Lordaeron. The Royal Apothecary Society's research helps defend those vulnerable borders.
